'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Olaf Schroeder DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Olaf Schroeder]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Transcription note: deck name struck out ("Worlds Dark"?); lines 39-40 numbered 37-38 on sheet; shields in heavy shorthand
